data.one_liner: Scope Provider or Bloc instances to specific go_router routes.
data.what_it_does: Provides GoProviderRoute and ShellProviderRoute widgets that attach providers to a route hierarchy. Providers are created when the route is entered and disposed when the route is popped, simplifying scoped state management with go_router.
use_when: You need route‑specific state without lifting providers to the app root
You use go_router and want automatic provider lifecycle tied to navigation
avoid_when: You prefer a global provider architecture
strengths: Easy integration with existing Provider or Bloc code
Works with custom pages via copyWith
weaknesses: Adds an extra Navigator which can affect canPop behavior
Limited to Provider/Bloc patterns, no built‑in support for Riverpod

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard way to scope providers manually in the widget tree

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar scoped Bloc support without extra routing wrapper
